_comment: Small manually checked smoke set. Source filenames and page numbers refer to the repository PDFs; this is not a statistically meaningful benchmark.

questions.question: How early must I give the hostel caretaker my leave form before leaving campus?
questions.notes: The 2025-26 hostel rules require the hard-copy H1 leave form at least 48 hours before departure. Verified against the PDF text.

questions.question: Can a student go home for a weekend, and what permission is needed?
questions.notes: Paraphrased query. Page 18 describes weekend eligibility for nearby students and parental consent endorsed by the warden. Verified against the PDF text.

questions.question: What must a student do to register for campus placements, and what conditions affect eligibility?
questions.notes: Page 1 describes the registration form, resume and fee, registration window, and eligibility conditions including active backlogs and PET. Verified against the PDF text.

questions.question: Does IIITDM have a veterinary clinic for students?
questions.notes: Out-of-scope check: no supporting veterinary clinic information was found in the available document collection during the BM25 inspection.
